protocol.amendment: Owner-directed PR11 corrections; one bundled matched native replay, archived controls, no parameter tuning
protocol.breakout: Any completed inside close invalidates developing break; new break timestamp creates fresh event ID; open-trade two-close thesis rule unchanged
protocol.cheap_source: Sealed Gate OHLCV and public contract snapshot; offline cached-bar summaries, zero new provider requests
protocol.continuation: Confirmed1h structure+ADX>=20; defended VWAP OR1h swing, existing impulse/touch/confirmation tolerances; EMA telemetry only
protocol.controls: Archived frozen setup-v1.1 and V4 structure, same sealed cohort. Corrected full-universe offline audit and same-cutoff selectors measure coverage only; no extra native sweep.
protocol.management: Full objective exit control; challenger one-third at first objective, remainder second objective only if present, new confirmed postfill swing beyond cost breakeven required to tighten; never widen
protocol.map4h: Four exact consecutive UTC1h bars; 2left/2right confirmed pivots; five complete4h bars readiness; join at15m OPEN
protocol.profile: Verified tape/receipt index; latest completed eligible anchor; real receipt time retained; missing historical input=>UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
protocol.regimes: 4h reliable confirmed map and barriers;1h confirmed structure/ADX; registered balance definition; EMA telemetry only
protocol.reversal: Prior completed day/session or confirmed1h swing boundary; excursion 0.1..1ATR and close reclaim; later bar <=4 bars confirms frozen pre-sweep local swing break OR >=0.8ATR displacement with rvol>=1.2
protocol.rotation: Authentic trade-derived contiguous profile only; frozen prior-session complete coverage; balanced context; edge excursion/rejection followed by inward confirmation; two adverse closes outside invalidates; unavailable history=>NOT_TESTED
protocol.selection: Top3 per playbook/side BEFORE deep work; developing condition, nearest relevant ATR-normalized location, activity, stable pair; existing setups and potential positions retained
sensitivity: Additional10bp/side turnover ledger sensitivity;not fresh replay or observed slippage
protocol.targets: Nearest favorable confirmed15m/1h swing, prior complete day/session and completed4h swing; reversal additionally frozen sessionVWAP/range midpoint. Reject insufficient first obstacle; no fallback3R except registered comparator
protocol.tuning: All rule changes after outcomes must be separately disclosed; no selecting winning periods/playbooks
